items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: That's the Robert Robichaud's song. That's Robichaud's song.

ctx.x: You got Neely Simmons? Who? Neely Simmons. Uh-huh. A tenaclar and a flute. Hmm. You got, uh, what's the rope you show? That's the Robert Robichaud's song. That's Robichaud's song.
Wait a second. Let me write it down. We're right on top of the microphone. Robichaud's song. There's a saxophone player, Edward Robichaud, right here, huh?
Yeah, right here. That's Neely Simmons. That's Robichaud's son. You know who'd play the drums?
